verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's own docs claim "automated tax calculations" and describe a guide for enabling taxes and adding tax rates, so core tax calculation is a documented capability. However, the setup guide suggests merchants add rates themselves, and nothing shows per-jurisdiction VAT/sales-tax handling, automatic rate updates, or fileable tax reports. Missing for 10: evidence of per-jurisdiction automatic calculation depth, rates kept current automatically, tax reports suitable for filing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, sales tax and VAT are calculated automatically per jurisdiction, with rates kept current and reports I can file from

citations.quote: Save time with automated tax calculations
This guide explains how to enable and configure taxes in WooCommerce, add tax rates, and understand each available setting.
